header: More from the Northstar research desk

items.title: The checklist we send with every proof
items.description: Eleven questions about data, code and consent. Authors answer them before the proof goes out, and the answers are published with the paper.

items.title: Why we stopped charging submission fees
items.description: By 2024, fee waivers already covered 41 per cent of submissions. So we dropped the fee and covered the gap with institutional seats.

items.title: 9,800 papers in one search index
items.description: The Lodestar archive now holds 9,800 papers going back to 2016. Here is how we cleaned ten years of metadata before making it searchable.
